articulation.label: stop
articulation.alt: stop: /s/ → /t/ → /ɑ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: spin
articulation.alt: spin: /s/ → /p/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: clap
articulation.alt: clap: /k/ → /l/ → /æ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: flag
articulation.alt: flag: /f/ → /l/ → /æ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
